# Failure Atlas — Full Context Specification

> Research-Grade Mechatronics, Robotics & Embedded Systems Failure Database and Reliability Analysis Suite.

## 1. System Overview
`failure-atlas` provides structured indexing, query tools, and mathematical reliability frameworks for analyzing engineering disasters, embedded software bugs, and robotic hardware failures.

Database schema per record:
- `id`: Unique identifier string (e.g. `FAIL-ROB-001`)
- `title`: Concise descriptive failure title
- `domain`: High-level domain (`Robotics`, `Embedded Systems`, `Electronics`, `Mechatronics`, `Software`, `Aerospace`)
- `subsystem`: Subsystem classification (e.g. `State Estimation`, `Firmware Communication`, `Power Distribution`)
- `severity`: Qualitative severity rating (`Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Critical`)
- `symptom`: Observable real-world system behavior
- `root_cause`: Underlying physical or software defect
- `causal_factors`: Array of relevant taxonomy tags
- `mitigation`: Recommended preventive architectural fix

## 2. Quantitative Reliability Formulations
1. **FMEA Risk Priority Number:**
   $$RPN = S \times O \times D$$
   where $S, O, D \in [1, 10]$. Threshold for mandatory mitigation: $RPN \ge 100$ or $S \ge 9$.

2. **MIL-STD-1629A Criticality Analysis:**
   $$C_m = \alpha \times \beta \times \lambda_p \times t$$
   $$C_r = \sum_{j=1}^m C_{m,j} = \sum_{j=1}^m \left(\alpha_j \beta_j \lambda_p t\right)$$

3. **5-State Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC):**
   State space $\mathcal{S} = \{S_1(\mathcal{N}), S_2(\mathcal{D}), S_3(\mathcal{F}), S_4(\mathcal{C}), S_5(\mathcal{E})\}$.
   Generator matrix $Q$:
   $$Q = \begin{bmatrix}
   -(\lambda_{12} + \lambda_{14}) & \lambda_{12} & 0 & \lambda_{14} & 0 \\
   \mu_{21} & -(\mu_{21} + \lambda_{23} + \lambda_{24}) & \lambda_{23} & \lambda_{24} & 0 \\
   \mu_{31} & \mu_{32} & -(\mu_{31} + \mu_{32} + \lambda_{35}) & 0 & \lambda_{35} \\
   0 & 0 & \mu_{43} & -(\mu_{43} + \lambda_{45}) & \lambda_{45} \\
   \mu_{51} & 0 & 0 & 0 & -\mu_{51}
   \end{bmatrix}$$
   Steady-state balance equations:
   $$\boldsymbol{\pi} Q = \mathbf{0}, \quad \sum_{i=1}^5 \pi_i = 1$$
   Absorption MTTF: $\text{MTTF} = \mathbf{e}_1^T (-Q_T)^{-1} \mathbf{1}$.

## 3. Verification Commands
```bash
pytest test/ -v
```
All 5 tests pass verifying dataset loading, domain searches, keyword filtering, and markdown report generation.
